result.summary: This PR changes two shell redirection operators in the offline-signing-tutorial.md from append (>>) to overwrite (>) so that funded_psbt.txt and final_psbt.txt always contain exactly one line. It fixes a documented bug where re-running the send or walletprocesspsbt steps without deleting the output file first would append a second line, causing later $(cat ...) invocations to word-split into multiple arguments and fail.
result.problem: Users following the offline-signing tutorial who re-run a step without manually deleting the intermediate file get a corrupted PSBT file and a confusing 'too many arguments' error from decodepsbt/walletprocesspsbt/sendrawtransaction. This affects anyone following the doc literally, especially newcomers to offline signing.

result.card: This PR fixes a one-character bug class in bitcoin/doc/offline-signing-tutorial.md, changing shell redirection from append (>>) to overwrite (>) for two PSBT output files. The problem: following the tutorial's send or walletprocesspsbt steps twice without manually deleting the output file appends a duplicate line, which later unquoted $(cat ...) invocations word-split into two arguments, breaking decodepsbt, walletprocesspsbt, or sendrawtransaction with a confusing error, as described in linked issue #35862. The fix is a trivial two-line diff with clear rationale in the commit message. Discussion so far concerns only the PR description's apparent AI-generated origin, which the author has since rewritten in their own words; the substantive fix is uncontested. No dependencies or blockers.
